dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Have a question for me, cutie?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: After observing your work, I made note of several improvements we can make to the brewing, cultivation, and sales aspects of the business.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Freda can tell you more about implementing these upgrades.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, if there's anything else you want to ask, don't hesitate to come and find me.
